items.idiom: leave the bike at any station
items.example: You can leave the bike at any station in the city.
items.mnemonic: Велосипедист в ливень оставляет велосипед — leave the bike at station.

items.example: Users pay 300 pesos by credit card for a year.
items.mnemonic: Юзер кричит «пей» и платит картой — pay by credit card.

items.idiom: go by bike when traffic is bad
items.example: I go by bike when the traffic is bad.
items.mnemonic: Курьер на байке едет в пробки — go by bike when traffic is bad.

items.idiom: ride in the middle of traffic
items.example: They ride in the middle of the traffic.
items.mnemonic: Велосипедист в мидле потока едет — ride in the middle of traffic.

items.example: Drivers have to be extra-careful now.
items.mnemonic: Водитель с кефиром осторожен — be extra-careful now.

items.example: Some cyclists go too fast in the city.
items.mnemonic: Курьер с фастфудом гонит слишком быстро — go too fast.

items.idiom: the traffic is almost always bad
items.example: In this city the traffic is almost always bad.
items.mnemonic: Водитель в трафике ворчит — the traffic is almost always bad, пробки всегда.
